neighbours.label: kissing and the lips (crushing his lips to mine, softly kissed him, a light kiss), as opposed to other touching and other parts of the face
fire: He leaned in and pressed his lips against hers.
She stood on her toes and quickly kissed him.
He raised her hand to his mouth for a soft kiss.
Her lips brushed my cheek in the dark.
They kissed for a long time on the porch.
He stole a kiss before the train left.
She bit her lip and looked away.
I felt his lips on my forehead.
quiet: He leaned in and pressed his hand against the door.
She stood on her toes and quickly waved at him.
He raised her hand to his chest for a long shake.
Her hair brushed my shoulder in the dark.
They talked for a long time on the porch.
He took a photo before the train left.
She closed her eyes and looked away.
I felt his hand on my shoulder.

notes: The card's other part is ' vowel' (a simple vowel, diphthong 0.66 in a probe), which is not tested. Perhaps it is 'the mouth'. ' mouth' in 'opened his mouth and yawned' stayed at 0.002.
